basic_details.job_title: ICAR-NBSS&LUP Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 3 Senior Project Associate, Junior Project Associate Posts
basic_details.short_information: The ICAR-National Bureau of Soil Survey and Land Use Planning Regional Centre, Kolkata is engaging 1 Sr. Project Associate (RS & GIS) at Rs. 45,000/- consolidated and 2 Jr. Project Associate (RS & GIS) at Rs. 35,000/- under the project "National Soil Mapping Programme (NSMP), 1:10K". The Sr. post needs a Post-Graduate degree with at least 3 years' experience and the Jr. post a Graduate degree with at least 2 years' experience. Applications are sent by email to [email protected] in the prescribed format, and the interview is on 9 December 2026 from 10:00 a.m. onwards.

age_limit.details: The minimum age is 21 years. The maximum is 40 years for men, 45 years for women/SC/ST/PwD and 43 years for OBC candidates, counted on the date of interview. Relaxation is as per the various categories instituted by the Government of India from time to time. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

qualification.details: Working knowledge in GIS & Remote Sensing based software. Working knowledge in RS & GIS based interpretation for mapping of landform, land use/land cover (LULC), DEM/DTM generation and soil resource-based mapping. Preference will be given to experienced candidates who have worked in similar institute and in similar areas. Well versed in computer programming/R-analysis.

how_to_apply: Take the prescribed application form attached to the notice (the notice says it is also provided on the website).
Fill in the form, including the post applied for, discipline, mobile number and email ID, and sign it. Applications without an email ID and mobile number are liable to be disqualified.
Affix a recent passport size colour photograph on the form.
Attach the self-attested documents listed below in a single PDF with the application form.
Email the advance copy to [email protected]. Send a separate application for each post.
Scanned copy of the application, duly filled and signed, in the prescribed format.
Scanned copy of date of birth certificate.
Scanned copy of marksheet/certificate of the minimum essential qualification.

Candidates employed in a Govt. organization must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the employer and the experience certificate in original at the time of interview. The notice says that only candidates who have sent all the documents as per their original certificates will be allowed to appear for the interview, which will be confirmed at the time of appointment.
important_instructions: The application must be submitted strictly in the prescribed format. Applications received after the stipulated last date of submission will not be entertained. The posts are purely on contractual basis and of temporary nature. Selected candidates will not be entitled to any claim for regular appointment/absorption in the Institute or in ICAR, nor to employment or engagement in ICAR at the end of the contract period. The place of posting will be either ICAR-NBSS&LUP, Regional Centre, Kolkata, or ICAR-NBSS&LUP, Nagpur, depending on the requirements and work demands of the project. Canvassing in any form will be liable to disqualify the candidature. The Director's decision will be final and binding in all respects. The Director/PI reserve the right to cancel/postpone the interview without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for 3 posts in total. It does not give a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Working knowledge in GIS & Remote Sensing based software. Working knowledge in RS & GIS based interpretation for mapping of landform, land use/land cover (LULC), DEM/DTM generation and soil resource-based mapping. Preference will be given to experienced candidates who have worked in similar institute and in similar areas. Well versed in computer programming/R-analysis. Experience in handling RS & GIS softwares, data management, base map preparation for soil survey, and soil and thematic mapping etc. Preference will be given to experienced candidates who have worked in similar institute and in similar areas. For both posts: knowledge of Hindi, Bengali or English (fluency in speaking and writing). The minimum age is 21 years. The maximum is 40 years for men, 45 years for women/SC/ST/PwD and 43 years for OBC candidates, counted on the date of interview. Relaxation is as per the various categories instituted by the Government of India from time to time. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: Post-Graduate in Agricultural Sciences/Basic Sciences/Geology/Geography/Remote Sensing & GIS/Geo-informatics/Computer Science with at least 3 years' experience in the respective discipline
Graduate in Agriculture & allied Sciences/Basic Sciences/Geography/Geoinformatics (at least 2 years' experience in the respective discipline)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Sr. Project Associate gets Rs. 45,000/- consolidated and the Jr. Project Associate gets Rs.35, 000/-. For both posts the job duration is 24 months or until termination of the project, whichever is earlier, and the position is to be renewed every year based on performance. The initial appointment will be for one year or earlier, whichever is less, and may be extended based on satisfactory performance and the requirement of the project. Selected candidates will not be liable to bear any expenditure on pension contribution, leave salary contribution, Provident Fund, ESI etc. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

content_sections.heading: ICAR-NBSS&LUP Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Remote sensing data interpretation, base map preparation, data interpretation. Soil and thematic mapping. Computer programming and computer-based data management. Statistical analysis using R and report writing. Remote sensing data interpretation for LULC, landform, slope, and base map preparation. Computer-based data management and statistical analysis using R, etc.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ICAR-NBSS&LUP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 posts: 1 Sr. Project Associate (RS & GIS) and 2 Jr. Project Associate (RS & GIS).

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for Sr. Project Associate (RS & GIS)?
faq.answer: Post-Graduate in Agricultural Sciences/Basic Sciences/Geology/Geography/Remote Sensing & GIS/Geo-informatics/Computer Science with at least 3 years' experience in the respective discipline.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Jr. Project Associate (RS & GIS)?
faq.answer: Graduate in Agriculture & allied Sciences/Basic Sciences/Geography/Geoinformatics, with at least 2 years' experience in the respective discipline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The minimum is 21 years. The maximum is 40 years for men, 45 years for women/SC/ST/PwD and 43 years for OBC, on the date of interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The Sr. Project Associate gets Rs. 45,000/- consolidated and the Jr. Project Associate gets Rs.35, 000/-.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email the signed application in the prescribed format, with a colour photograph and self-attested documents in a single PDF, to [email protected]. Send a separate application for each post.

faq.question: Q7. When is the interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 9 December 2026 from 10:00 a.m. onwards. The Director/PI may cancel or postpone it without giving a reason.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely contractual and temporary, for 24 months or until the project ends, whichever is earlier, with renewal every year based on performance.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: Either ICAR-NBSS&LUP, Regional Centre, Kolkata, or ICAR-NBSS&LUP, Nagpur, depending on the requirements and work demands of the project.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.
